arxiv-2103-12344.title: Joint Distribution across Representation Space for Out-of-Distribution Detection
arxiv-2103-12344.creator: Jingwei Xu, Siyuan Zhu, Zenan Li, Chang Xu
arxiv-2103-12344.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jingwei Xu, Siyuan Zhu, Zenan Li, Chang Xu. Deep neural networks (DNNs) have become a key part of many modern software applications. After training and validating, the DNN is deployed as an irrevocable component and applied in real-world scenarios. Although most DNNs are built meticulously with huge volumes of training data, data in the real world still remain unknown to the DNN model, which leads to the crucial requirement of runtime out-of-distribution ( OOD ) detection.

arxiv-2109-03465.title: A Survey of Sound Source Localization with Deep Learning Methods
arxiv-2109-03465.creator: Pierre-Amaury Grumiaux, Srđan Kitić, Laurent Girin, Alexandre Guérin
arxiv-2109-03465.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Pierre-Amaury Grumiaux, Srđan Kitić, Laurent Girin, Alexandre Guérin. This article is a survey of deep learning methods for single and multiple sound source localization, with a focus on sound source localization in indoor environments, where reverberation and diffuse noise are present.

arxiv-2110-05025.title: Self-supervised Learning is More Robust to Dataset Imbalance
arxiv-2110-05025.creator: Hong Liu, Jeff Z. HaoChen, Adrien Gaidon, Tengyu Ma
arxiv-2110-05025.description: Abstract Self-supervised learning (SSL) is a scalable way to learn general visual representations since it learns without labels. However, large-scale unlabeled datasets in the wild often have long-tailed label distributions, where we know little about the behavior of SSL. In this work, we systematically investigate self-supervised learning under dataset imbalance.

arxiv-2312-07672.title: Topological Signal Processing on Quantum Computers for Higher-Order Network Analysis
arxiv-2312-07672.creator: Caesnan M. G. Leditto, Angus Southwell, Behnam Tonekaboni, Gregory A. L. White, Muhammad Usman, Kavan Modi
arxiv-2312-07672.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Caesnan M. G. Leditto, Angus Southwell, Behnam Tonekaboni, Gregory A. L. White, Muhammad Usman, Kavan Modi. Predicting and analyzing global behaviour of complex systems is challenging due to the intricate nature of their component interactions. Recent work has started modelling complex systems using networks endowed with multiway interactions among nodes, known as higher-order networks. Simplicial complexes are a class of higher-order networks that have received significant attention due to their topological structure and connections to Hodge theory.

arxiv-2403-18732.title: Identifying CP Basis Invariants in SMEFT
arxiv-2403-18732.creator: Neda Darvishi, Yining Wang, Jiang-Hao Yu
arxiv-2403-18732.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Neda Darvishi, Yining Wang, Jiang-Hao Yu. Building on our automated framework that uses ring diagrams for classifying CP basis invariants [ 1 ] , this paper broadens the application of the methodology with more extensive examples and a wider scope of theoretical frameworks. Here, we showcase its versatility through detailed analyses in the Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT) up to dim- 2 ​ n 2n , and SMEFT with sterile neutrinos ( ν \nu SMEFT) up to dimension-7.

arxiv-2405-16989.title: Uncertainty Learning for High-dimensional Mean-variance Portfolio
arxiv-2405-16989.creator: Ruike Wu, Yanrong Yang, Han Lin Shang, Huanjun Zhu
arxiv-2405-16989.description: Abstract Robust estimation for modern portfolio selection on a large set of assets becomes more important due to large deviation of empirical inference on big data. We propose a distributionally robust methodology for high-dimensional mean-variance portfolio problem, aiming to select an optimal conservative portfolio allocation by taking distribution uncertainty into account.

arxiv-2412-04098.title: Magnetically-controlled Vortex Dynamics in a Ferromagnetic Superconductor
arxiv-2412-04098.creator: Joseph Alec Wilcox, Lukas Schneider, Estefani Marchiori, Vadim Plastovets, Alexandre Buzdin, Pardis Sahafi, Andrew Jordan, Raffi Budakian, Tong Ren, Ivan Veshchunov, Tsuyoshi Tamegai, Sven Friedemann, Martino Poggio, Simon John Bending
arxiv-2412-04098.description: Abstract Ferromagnetic superconductors are exceptionally rare because the strong ferromagnetic exchange field usually destroys singlet superconductivity. EuFe 2 (As 1-x P x ) 2 , an iron-based superconductor with a maximum critical temperature of 25 K, uniquely exhibits full coexistence with ferromagnetic order below T FM T_{\mathrm{FM}} ≃ \simeq 19 19 K.

arxiv-2511-10350.title: A predictive framework for realistic star–planet radio emission in compact systems
arxiv-2511-10350.creator: J. J. Chebly, C. K. Louis, A. Strugarek, J. D. Alvarado Gómez, P. Zarka
arxiv-2511-10350.description: Abstract Context: Radio emission from star–planet interactions (SPI) beyond our solar system has yet to be firmly detected, primarily due to challenges such as weak signals, directional beaming effects, and low-frequency emissions that are blocked by Earth’s ionosphere. Addressing these obstacles calls for strategic target selection.

pmc-10752075.title: The Plumbline: A Novel Radiographic Tool for Assessment of Metatarsus Adductus with Hallux Valgus
pmc-10752075.creator: Jody P. McAleer, William T. DeCarbo, Robert D. Santrock
pmc-10752075.description: Category:Bunion; Midfoot/ForefootIntroduction/Purpose:Metatarsus adductus (MTA) is a complex multiplanar deformity of the foot which has a 30% reported approximate radiographic incidence in patients with symptomatic hallux valgus (HV). Various radiographic angles have been proposed for the assessment of MTA, but these measurements can be complex with a broad range of interrater reliability.

pmc-11323320.title: Redox-active chemical chaperones exhibiting promiscuous binding promote oxidative protein folding under condensed sub-millimolar conditions†
pmc-11323320.creator: Koki Suzuki, Ryoya Nojiri, Motonori Matsusaki, Takuya Mabuchi, Shingo Kanemura, Kotone Ishii, Hiroyuki Kumeta, Masaki Okumura, Tomohide Saio, Takahiro Muraoka
pmc-11323320.description: Proteins form native structures through folding processes, many of which proceed through intramolecular hydrophobic effect, hydrogen bond and disulfide-bond formation. In vivo, protein aggregation is prevented even in the highly condensed milieu of a cell through folding mediated by molecular chaperones and oxidative enzymes. Chemical approaches to date have not replicated such exquisite mediation.

pmc-11484331.title: Suppression of virulence factors of uropathogenic Escherichia coli by Trans-resveratrol and design of nanoemulgel
pmc-11484331.creator: Dalia Saad ElFeky, Abeer Ahmed Kassem, Mona A Moustafa, Hanan Assiri, Areej M El-Mahdy
pmc-11484331.description: BackgroundDevelopment of multidrug resistance in Uropathogenic Escherichia coli (UPEC) makes treatment of Urinary Tract Infections (UTIs) a major challenge. This study was conducted to investigate the effect of trans-resveratrol (t-RSV) at a subinhibitory concentration (sub-MIC-t-RSV) on phenotypic and genotypic expression of virulence factors of clinical isolates of UPEC and develop a nanoformulation of t-RSV.

pmc-11607321.title: Synthetic augmentation of cancer cell line multi-omic datasets using unsupervised deep learning
pmc-11607321.creator: Zhaoxiang Cai, Sofia Apolinário, Ana R Baião, Clare Pacini, Miguel D Sousa, Susana Vinga, Roger R Reddel, Phillip J Robinson, Mathew J Garnett, Qing Zhong, Emanuel Gonçalves
pmc-11607321.description: Integrating diverse types of biological data is essential for a holistic understanding of cancer biology, yet it remains challenging due to data heterogeneity, complexity, and sparsity. Addressing this, our study introduces an unsupervised deep learning model, MOSA (Multi-Omic Synthetic Augmentation), specifically designed to integrate and augment the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap).

pmc-12680514.title: Empowering patients through effective communication: The teach-back method as a tool for health literacy
pmc-12680514.creator: Hassan Mahmoodi
pmc-12680514.description: althcare professionals must cultivate strong communication skills, and the teach-back method emerges as a crucial strategy.3 The teach-back method is a patient-centered communication technique in which healthcare providers convey important medical information—such as diagnoses, treatment plans, or self-care instructions—and then ask patients to restate the information in their own words.

pmc-12973030.title: Clinical and Radiological Outcomes of Pediatric Femoral Neck Fractures Treated with Surgical Internal Fixation: A Retrospective Case Series
pmc-12973030.creator: Wajahat Ahmad Mir, Abhishek Raina, Niaz Ahmed, Sukhmin Singh, Umesh Kumar Bahagotia, Anirudh Dwajan
pmc-12973030.description: Introduction:Femoral neck fractures in children are rare injuries associated with a high risk of complications, particularly avascular necrosis (AVN) of the femoral head. The purpose of this retrospective study was to evaluate the functional and radiological outcomes of pediatric femoral neck fractures treated surgically and to assess factors influencing clinical outcomes.

pmc-12980906.creator: Narjes Yazdi, Negar Pourjamal, Hao Li, Pirjo Laakkonen, Heikki Joensuu, Mark Barok

BackgroundMost human epidermal growth factor-2 (HER2)-positive breast and gastric cancers eventually become resistant to HER2-targeting antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), such as trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) and trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1), which are widely used for their treatment.

pmc-13181409.description: Engineered wheat produces natural antioxidant pigments in whole plants and flour, enabling healthier, visually distinctive foods and offering a tool to study gene activity in specific tissues. pmc-13261756.title: Emerging reservoirs of metallo-β-lactamase genes among non-aeruginosa Pseudomonas and Stutzerimonas species in a Spanish tertiary hospital
pmc-13261756.creator: Guillem Puigsech-Boixeda, Albert Moreno-Mingorance, Ester del Barrio-Tofiño, Virginia Rodríguez-Garrido, Alba Mir-Cros, Josep Roca-Grande, Xavier Nuvials, Dolors Rodríguez-Pardo, Agustín Gayubas, Sílvia Aneas, Adaia Albasanz-Puig, Yannick Hoyos-Mallecot, Jesús Trejo-Zahinos, Mayli Lung, Paula Salmer
pmc-13261756.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionPseudomonas is one of the largest genera among Gram-negative bacteria, currently comprising nearly 400 valid species. Among them, non-aeruginosa Pseudomonas species, together with Stutzerimonas—a genus recently separated from Pseudomonas—are becoming important reservoirs of antimicrobial resistance genes. However, accurate species-level identification of these organisms remains challenging when relying on the methods routinely implemented in most clinical microbiology laboratories, such as MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry. Therefore, this study aimed to identify and characterize metallo-β-lactamase-producing non-aeruginosa Pseudomonas spp. and Stutzerimonas spp.

pmc-13527311.title: Analysis of the curative effect of arthroscopic coracoid process drill-free U-shaped suspension fixation in the treatment of acute acromioclavicular joint dislocation
pmc-13527311.creator: Gushang Xia, Yongsheng Liu, Daohong Zhao
pmc-13527311.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to investigate the clinical effect of arthroscopic coracoid process drill-free U-shaped suspension fixation in the treatment of acute acromioclavicular joint dislocation.MethodsThis retrospective clinical study analyzed the data of 25 patients with acute acromioclavicular joint dislocation. pmc-13532599.title: Impact of Operator Specialization and On‐Site Evaluation on Nondiagnostic Thyroid Fine‐Needle Aspiration: A Comparative Study
pmc-13532599.creator: Fatlinda Sadiku, Marija Škerlj, Vesna Ramljak
pmc-13532599.description: BackgroundThyroid fine‐needle aspiration (FNA) is the primary diagnostic method for evaluating thyroid nodules; however, nondiagnostic results remain a significant limitation, often leading to repeat procedures and delayed diagnosis. Operator specialization and rapid on‐site evaluation (ROSE) have been proposed as strategies to improve specimen adequacy.

uslaw-usc-t16-s698u4.title: 16 U.S.C. § 698u–4 — Limited authority to acquire
uslaw-usc-t16-s698u4.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s698u4.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 6 (Game And Bird Preserves; Protection). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In general The Secretary shall acquire, by donation, not more than 180 acres of real property within the boundaries of the Preserve (as described in section 698u–2(b) of this title) and the improvements on the real property. (b) Payments in lieu of taxes.
